svg.title: Understand terminal terms through the devices they describe
svg.desc: A teletype-style keyboard and printer leads to a physical screen terminal and then a terminal-emulator window. TTY preserves the older name. The lower cutaway shows three alternative programs inside the interface: a shell receiving commands, an editor receiving document text, or an agent receiving a research prompt. The hardware drawings are original schematic illustrations, not particular models.
svg.text: From a physical device to a software window
TTY retains the older name: teletype
The same terminal interface can host different programs
